review_candidates.title: Platform Engineer
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Key Responsibilities: DevOps & Automation: Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for automated testing, integration, and deployment across infrastructure and applications. Server Support & Operations: Administer, patch, and troubleshoot Windows and Linux/UNIX server environments, both on-premises and in the cloud. Cloud Engineering: Design, deploy, and maintain cloud infrastructure (AWS and/or Azure), including compute, storage, networking, and identity, with a focus on scalability, cost efficiency
eligibility_evidence: Implement cloud-native and hybrid solutions using infrastructure as code (Terraform, CloudFormation, or equivalent) to ensure repeatable, version-controlled provisioning.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: This is a hands-on role centered on cloud engineering and DevOps, with the engineer owning infrastructure as code, automation, and CI/CD to deliver scalable, secure, and reliable platforms. Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a closely related field, or equivalent experience. 5+ years of experience in cloud engineering, DevOps, systems administration, or a closely related infrastructure role. Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud provider (AWS or Azure); multi-cloud experience a plus. Proficiency with infrastructure as code (Terraform, CloudFormation, ARM/Bicep, or similar). Physical Requirements: Prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer.
